---
title: "Voicenotes Android beta"
---

The companion syncs saved recordings from a fēnix 8 paired in Garmin Connect. When the inbox is open, it checks the selected watch automatically. Use **Sync now** on the phone or watch to start a check immediately. Keep Voicenotes open on the watch for the first sync.

The phone saves recordings locally for playback and sharing. The watch shows **On phone** after it receives confirmation that the phone saved the complete file. The original stays on the watch. The beta remembers which recordings it transferred through those watch receipts, so keep an exported copy before uninstalling or clearing the phone app if you need to retain its inbox.

## Install the beta

1. Install `bin/android/Voicenotes-beta.apk` on an Android 11 or newer phone. With USB debugging enabled, use `adb -d install -r bin/android/Voicenotes-beta.apk`.
2. Confirm the fēnix 8 is paired and connected in Garmin Connect.
3. Copy the matching signed `.prg` into the watch's `GARMIN/APPS` folder by USB. Garmin's developer reference groups the 47 mm and 51 mm AMOLED watches under one device profile. [Garmin device reference](https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/device-reference/)

   | fēnix 8 variant | Watch build |
   | --- | --- |
   | 43 mm AMOLED | `bin/Voicenotes-fenix843mm.prg` |
   | 47 mm or 51 mm AMOLED | `bin/Voicenotes-fenix847mm.prg` |
   | 47 mm Solar | `bin/Voicenotes-fenix8solar47mm.prg` |
   | 51 mm Solar | `bin/Voicenotes-fenix8solar51mm.prg` |

4. Open Voicenotes on both devices. If Garmin Connect lists multiple watches, choose the fēnix 8 in the inbox.
5. To try finishing an active transfer after screen lock, tap **Allow sync to finish while locked** and grant Nearby devices and notification access when prompted. The phone attempts to finish the current recording for up to three minutes. If it pauses, open the inbox to resume.

## Build from source

The build requires access to the private Android companion source. The recipes look for it at `~/src/garmin-voicenotes-companion`. Set `VOICENOTES_COMPANION_DIR` if you keep it elsewhere.

Set `ANDROID_HOME` to the Android SDK with platform 37 installed. Use a Gradle-compatible JDK 17 or newer. Run `just android-beta` to produce the debug-signed APK at `bin/android/Voicenotes-beta.apk`. Android requires the same signing key for in-place upgrades. Keep the local debug signing key if you want to install later beta builds over this one.

Run `bash build.sh --companion --device <profile>` (or `just garmin-build-companion`) with the profile from the table to produce `bin/Voicenotes.prg`. The companion sync code is behind the `companion` build flag and is not part of default builds or the store package. Reuse the same Garmin developer key for watch updates. The [tethered demo](android-demo.qmd) is separately installable as `ch.voicenotes.inbox`.

## Preview in the Android emulator

Run `just android-emulator` in one terminal. Once the emulator reaches the Android home screen, run `just android-preview` in another terminal to install and open the beta APK. If you have several emulators running, use `just android-preview beta emulator-5554` with the serial shown by `adb devices`.

For a preview with recordings transferred from the Garmin simulator, use the [tethered demo](android-demo.qmd).

## Physical-device acceptance

- Record on the fēnix 8 with the HTTPS receiver stopped. Confirm the phone shows the recording with its recording date, the watch shows **On phone**, and the original file plays and opens from the Android Sharesheet.
- Interrupt Bluetooth after the progress indicator starts. Reconnect, then verify the note resumes and appears once. Repeat with the phone screen locked and record whether transfer finished while locked or resumed when the inbox reopened.
- Close Voicenotes on the watch before the next sync. If the phone stops receiving replies, reopen the watch app and confirm it can finish the queued note.
- Record the exact watch variant, watch firmware, Android version, and the screen-lock result with the beta test results.

Host-side storage checks are available with `just test-android-storage`. The [simulator test guide](run-simulator-tests.qmd) covers the tethered end-to-end tests.
